identificationModule.briefTitle: A Multi-Center Study of Ibrutinib in Combination With Obinutuzumab Versus Chlorambucil in Combination With Obinutuzumab in Patients With Treatment naïve Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) or Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma (SLL)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Multi-center, Open-label, Phase 3 Study of the Bruton's Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor Ibrutinib in Combination With Obinutuzumab Versus Chlorambucil in Combination With Obinutuzumab in Subjects With Treatment-naïve Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia or Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma

armGroups.label: IBR + OB
armGroups.description: Ibrutinib (IBR) given orally at a dose of 420 mg/day until progressive disease or unacceptable toxicity. Intravenous obinutuzumab (OB) given on Days 1 and 2 (100 mg on Day 1 and 900 mg on Day 2), 1000 mg on Days 8 and 15 of Cycle 1 and 1000 mg on Day 1 of each cycle up to 6 cycles or until progressive disease or unacceptable toxicity.

armGroups.label: CLB + OB
armGroups.description:
Chlorambucil (CLB) given orally at a dose of 0.5 mg/kg body weight up to a total of 6 cycles on Days 1 and 15 of each cycle or until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

Intravenous obinutuzumab given on Days 1 and 2 (100 mg on Day 1 and 900 mg on Day 2), 1000 mg on Days 8 and 15 of Cycle 1 and 1000 mg on Day 1 of each cycle up to 6 cycles or until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

interventions.name: Ibrutinib
interventions.description: Ibrutinib will be supplied as 140 mg hard gelatin capsules for oral (PO) administration.

interventions.name: Obinutuzumab
interventions.description: Obinutuzumab will be supplied as 1000 mg/40 mL solution in a single-use vial for intravenous (IV) administration

interventions.name: Chlorambucil
interventions.description: Chlorambucil will be supplied as 2 mg film-coated tablets for oral (PO) administration
